block_readings.visual_reading: Only two original centres occur in the eastern frame edge:9416 is in the dark lagoon-water context;9417 is on the bright shallow southern reef rim and retains exposure uncertainty. Scattered clouds elsewhere do not cover either centre.

The western chain crosses a shallow reef rim and dark channels, while both eastern groups lie in dark open water between separate small cloud/shadow pairs. Thirteen exact bright/variegated reef centres remain exposure questions; all other marked centres show continuous dated water appearance, including visibly dark channels/lagoon margins. No exact centre is on a distinct constructed or vegetated land body.
